versions.changelog:
Initial release of the “pdp-faq-from-support” skill.

- Converts recurring pre-purchase customer doubts from support interactions into effective product detail page (PDP) FAQs and trust-building content.
- Enforces a structured workflow: data ingestion sketch, theme extraction, evidence, PDP placement mapping, and rewritten on-page copy with rationale.
- Provides a mandatory, structured Markdown output table mapping high-impact customer doubts to actionable PDP content.
- Includes clear criteria and guardrails on when not to use the skill (e.g., for SEO-only or post-purchase policy content).
- Offers methodology guidance and a minimal data request workflow if raw support data is missing.
